name: GENESIS ARCHIVE #001 — The Human Continuity NFT
description: A one-of-one AI-assisted digital artwork conceived as the visual frontispiece for a proposed Human Continuity Archive. The hourglass holds Earth as memory and a regenerative future as possibility; its surrounding symbols reference health, knowledge, clean energy, ecology, cooperation, justice and exploration. This token represents ownership of the ERC-721 token only. It does not represent shares, investment returns, ownership of a fund or organization, governance rights, or a claim on future projects. The artwork is AI-assisted; copyright and commercial-use rights are not transferred by token ownership unless a separate written agreement says so.

properties.provenance: See docs/PROVENANCE_AND_RIGHTS.md in the release package.
